title: A/R Summary keeps its columns and leaves empty buckets blank
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in to ShopView as an Admin user.
  • Customer X has open invoices in only one bucket.
custom_steps:
1. Open the Reports menu.
  2. Click "A/R Aging Summary" in the left list.
  3. Read the column headings left to right.
  4. Find customer X.
  5. Read customer X's empty buckets.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 3:

  • Customer, then Current, 1-30 Days, 31-60 Days, 61-90 Days, 91 And Over, Total. (A Location column after Customer when two or more locations are in view is new by design.)

Step 5:

  • the buckets with nothing in them are blank, not $0.00.

Why this matters: The layout users reconcile against QuickBooks must not change.

SOURCE: ShopView/shopview at fc08f23 (production v26.45.3), app/src/components/ts/reporting/accounts-receivable/AgingSummaryReport.vue:213-269; app/src/utils/reporting.ts:9-11; api/src/Reporting/Dashboard/Application/AccountReceivable/AgingSummary/AgingSummaryItem.php:9-18. V1 code, quoted: `label: 'Customer' ... '1-30 Days' ... '31-60 Days' ... '61-90 Days' ... '91 and Over' ... 'Total'`

This is the expected behaviour as per the V1 code baseline AR-AP-V1-BASELINE.md (INV-050, INV-052) for epic SV-11315; the A/R and A/P Report Sorting PRD v11 (Confluence 947650561) does not change it. Not yet checked against any build.

AUTOMATION: READY
